notes.subject: כחצת הלילה
notes.rationale: 'Likely-halving of the night' — i.e. 'about midnight'; some read the kaf as comparative 'about', others as 'at the bisection of the night' exactly.

notes.subject: יוצא
notes.rationale: Participle 'I am going out' — Tpi 'mi raun i go i kam' (walk about); second option 'mi kamap

notes.subject: to Pharaoh / Mitsrayim
notes.rationale: Moses relays a direct first-person declaration of Yahwe addressed to Pharaoh and Egypt.

translation: Na Mose i tok: Olsem Yahwe i tok: Long bel bilong hap bilong nait, mi raun i go ⟨i⟩ kam long namel bilong Mitsrayim.

tokens.gloss: long bel bilong hap bilong nait
